# ghost/kfz-a

KFZ-A (F-Droid): look up the district, federal state and type behind an Austrian licence plate code such as W or GU. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/kfz-a
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/kfz-a open_lookup --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/kfz-a lookup --device <serial> --param code=<code>
ghost skill run ghost/kfz-a lookup_many --device <serial> --param codes=<codes>
ghost skill run ghost/kfz-a get_result --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_lookup`: Open the Austrian licence plate lookup
- `lookup`: Which Austrian city has the licence plate code W?
- `lookup_many`: Look up the Austrian plate codes W, G and S
- `get_result`: What does the plate lookup show now?
